one_liner: A disease-first rare-disease repurposing demo with cell-perturbation evidence and hash-verifiable custody.

demo_flow.title: Rare disease query
demo_flow.message: Start with a disease-first question instead of a compound-first dashboard.

demo_flow.title: Prescripted validation
demo_flow.message: Elamipretide is identified as already tried/covered by GAP rule G004_ALREADY_TRIED, so the deterministic grade is NOT_A_GAP.

demo_flow.title: Live option
demo_flow.message: The live path checks current trial records but abstains from full gap grading until all joins are wired.

demo_flow.title: Phenotypic restoration
demo_flow.message: Candidate profiles are ranked by return toward the reference phenotype, not by claimed treatment effect.

demo_flow.title: FCO/FCG custody
demo_flow.message: Each source, calculation, model, subagent, and integration object is hash-addressed and queryable.

demo_flow.title: Tamper failure
demo_flow.message: A one-record edit causes the rebuilt root to mismatch and names the divergent node.

core_terms.FCO: Fractal Custody Object: one content-addressed evidence, model, agent, or integration record.
core_terms.FCG: Fractal Custody Graph: linked FCO-style records whose hashes and inputs preserve custody.
core_terms.GAP_lane: Deterministic rare disease repurposing gap finder: disease -> targets -> programs -> prior trials -> rule grade.
core_terms.MMR: Maximal Marginal Relevance, cited for diversity-aware reranking design; not required for the primary restoration-distance result.
core_terms.Merkle_root: A single hash committing to the ordered set of custody records under the declared RFC 6962 convention.

allowed_claims: The CPJUMP1 figure is a processed-profile phenotypic restoration benchmark.
The Elvis component includes an offline prescripted validation and a live ClinicalTrials probe.
The GAP lane rules are deterministic and refuse therapeutic recommendation output.
OpenAI fan-out outputs are recorded as custody objects.
The API key is used locally and is not committed.
prohibited_claims: full live Convoke/Open Targets integration unless demonstrated
